build_graph_network: build an InteractionNetwork with MLP update functions using build_gn for node and edge processing
build_update_function: build an MLP update function with optional layer or batch normalization using build_update_fn
create_node_property_model: create a NodePropertyEncodeProcessDecode model for node property prediction on graph data
run_graph_neural_network: run the encode-process-decode pipeline on a jraph GraphsTuple to get node embeddings and logits
review_model_output: review the ModelOutput NamedTuple containing node embeddings, projections, predictions, and logits
